planted.text: burned an hour this morning on my little cache-poking script. It reports 12 hits out of 40k and I nearly re-budgeted the whole persona run on that. Turns out the script does os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/curator") and I have had CURATOR_CACHE_DIR=/mnt/scratch/curator-cache in my shell profile since June. The numbers were from a directory nothing has written to since October.
planted.settles: the team agrees a hand-built home-directory path gives wrong numbers when CURATOR_CACHE_DIR is set
